name: minimax-music-ui
description: Suno-style web UI for a self-hosted MiniMax-Music3 inference server

paragraphs: A Suno-style web interface for any self-hosted MiniMax-Music3 server.
Write a style prompt and lyrics, queue takes, watch them render, and keep a local library with a waveform player.
Talks the standard POST /v1/audio/speech route, so it works with sgl-omni serve out of the box.
features: Create panel — Simple or Custom mode, song title (random name like “Velvet Horizon” if left empty), style description, lyrics editor with [Verse] / [Chorus] / … tag chips, instrumental toggle, duration 5–360 s, 1–4…
Templates — a built-in default plus your own saved templates (style, lyrics, duration), stored server-side.

Prompt enhancement — the magic wand at the top right of the prompt field rewrites your description into a structured MiniMax Music 3 caption (Global Metadata / Vocal Details / Arrangement) using MiniMax's own…

Lyrics writing — a second wand on the lyrics field writes original lyrics from the song description with the same LLM, sized to the chosen duration and using the model's section tags ([Verse], [Chorus], …). It replaces…

Render queue — the UI server renders one track at a time against the blocking /v1/audio/speech route and shows queued / rendering / done with elapsed time and an estimated bar (3× realtime — the official API reports no…

whatItDoes.text: A Suno-style web interface for any self-hosted MiniMax-Music3 server.

requirements.text: Settings page — point the app at your inference server (URL + optional API key) from the UI, with a "Test connection" button.
For any other address open Settings in the sidebar and enter the URL (and API key, if the server needs one).
